summary: First full test run of ANORA (React + FastAPI + MongoDB) e-commerce MVP. Backend API coverage via pytest (44 integration tests + 6 unit = 50 passed). Covered: catalog, consent/newsletter/contact, CSRF Origin guard, auth (register/login/me/logout/forgot/bcrypt), brute-force lockout, cart validation + tampering + coupon WELCOME10, checkout pending_payment flow, idempotency, verify bad-signature rejected, webhook HMAC + Mongo-level idempotency (stock & sales_count decremented once across duplicate event_id and distinct event_ids for same order), admin login/metrics/products/orders/coupons CRUD + 403/401 authorization. Frontend tested on desktop 1920x1080: homepage (hero CTAs present, Co-ord Sets & Sale hidden, Bestsellers hidden, New Arrivals shown), cookie banner + persistence, PDP add-to-bag + size-error + bag drawer + JSON-LD, invalid pincode handling, search overlay (returns 2 results for 'kurta', Escape closes), shop filter-size-M present, 404 page, admin login redirect + payments-not-configured warning, full pending_payment checkout flow (no coupon) end-to-end succeeded.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Nested <form onSubmit={applyCoupon}> is placed INSIDE the outer <form onSubmit={place}>. Nested forms are invalid HTML; the browser flattens them. Result: clicking the coupon 'Apply' button (which lacks type='button') submits the OUTER form via default GET action → URL becomes /checkout? and the entire React component unmounts/remounts, wiping email/name/phone/address state. User who ever tries to apply a coupon must refill the entire checkout form. Repro: on /checkout fill all fields, type WELCOME10 in coupon input, click Apply → page reloads to /checkout? with empty fields and validation errors. Fix: add type="button" to coupon-apply-button AND bind onClick={applyCoupon} instead of nesting a <form>, OR move the coupon <form> outside the main checkout form.

Button label reads 'Pay ₹X,XXX' even when Razorpay is not configured and the actual action is to create a pending_payment order. Misleading UX for store owner during the setup phase. Suggest conditionally rendering 'Place order (awaiting payment)' when meta.payment_configured is false.
React dev warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' Appears on every page. Should be renamed to the camelCase prop fetchPriority in the component emitting or .

This currently blocks any customer who tries to use a promo code (including WELCOME10).

Verified behaviour via webhook test (same order, two different event_ids → stock decremented exactly once, sales_count +1 once).

routes_catalog.py has_sales_data flag drives Bestsellers visibility — any paid order flips it. Testing agent reset is_demo products' sales_count to 0 after webhook idempotency test to keep storefront Bestsellers hidden as required.
server.py CSRF Origin middleware correctly blocks POST from foreign origins and bypasses /api/webhooks/*. Verified with 403 response from https://evil.example.com origin.

routes_auth.py brute-force uses login_attempts collection; count>=5 sets locked_until (ISO string) and returns 429. String comparison of ISO timestamps is OK for ascending format but could silently stop locking after year 9999 — currently acceptable.
Pydantic model LineIn correctly caps qty at MAX_QTY_PER_LINE (5); tampered qty=50 is rejected with 422 before pricing — good.
Checkout prices come from DB in price_cart; client-supplied price is ignored. Verified via cart/validate response unit_price matching DB.
Admin product create validates slug/sku uniqueness and compare_at_price > price. Working.
No MongoDB _id leaks observed in any public response.
Nested <form> in Checkout.jsx Summary — see UI bugs; this is the single most impactful defect found.

rca of the issue: Checkout.jsx line 29-36 wraps the promo-code input + Apply button in <form onSubmit={applyCoupon}>, but this Summary is already rendered inside the outer <form onSubmit={place}> on line 148. HTML forbids nested <form> elements; the browser treats the inner <form> start tag as a no-op and the Apply <button> defaults to type='submit', firing the OUTER form. Because the outer form has no action attribute, the default GET submission reloads /checkout?… wiping all React state. Mitigation: add type='button' to coupon-apply-button and change the inner <form> to <div> with an onClick (or form.onSubmit) binding; alternatively render the Summary outside the outer <form>.
